explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/836 (Erdős–Shelah): must an intersecting r-uniform hypergraph with chromatic number 3 have O(r²) vertices? No, by Alon's construction with ≍ 4^r/√r vertices. The statement negates a uniform C·r² bound on the number of non-isolated vertices (the union of edges), which is the meaningful count. 'Chromatic number 3' is read as exactly 3, the standard reading. Faithful.
